day_shape: Strait of Hormuz standoff dominates: UKMTO reports tanker hit by projectile, Qalibaf repeats seven-condition closure demand, Trump says 'all options' open as Camp David meeting and carrier movement reported, rial at record low, two Iranians charged in London bomb-plot case.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz closure and tanker incident
threads.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, while Parliament speaker Qalibaf said the strait would not reopen until Iran's seven Islamabad-agreement conditions were met. Nournews and IRIB carried the same line from Qalibaf.

threads.label: US military posture and Trump decision point
threads.summary: Iran International reported a Camp David national security meeting and additional carrier and troop movements toward the Middle East, with Trump saying Iran faced "the easy way or the hard way." Defense Secretary Hegseth warned Tehran to abandon nuclear ambitions or face further US action; CENTCOM posted Osprey refuelling footage.

threads.label: Iranian deterrence and retaliation messaging
threads.summary: Army spokesperson told Fars Iran would increase missile range, and Quds Force deputy Mosajedi told Defa Press any US ground attack would be defeated. Foreign Minister Araghchi said Iran would "defend ourselves more strongly than before," and spokesperson Baghaii accused NATO of direct participation in aggression against Iran.

threads.label: UK Iranian terror plot cases
threads.summary: Two Iranian nationals appeared in a London court charged with plotting a homemade-bomb attack on the Jewish community, per Jerusalem Post. A dual UK-Iranian national arrested over the suspected RAF Fairford bomb plot was released on bail.

threads.label: Iran economy and domestic pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported the rial hit a new record low against the dollar under US sanctions pressure, while IRIB said the Tehran stock index fell 24,789 points to 7.78m. An MP on the parliamentary health committee said patients were selling assets to fund care no longer covered by insurance.

threads.label: Gaza and Lebanon operations
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck Hamas Gaza political-bureau deputy Ali al-Amoudi overnight with results under review, and killed two Palestinian Islamic Jihad commanders Ramlawi and Masri in Gaza City. In southern Lebanon, one soldier was severely wounded and an officer moderately hurt in an accidental grenade explosion on Friday.

threads.label: Rajaei Shahr prison and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported authorities demolished one of the last watchtowers at Rajaei Shahr (Gohardasht) prison, a site of past mass political executions, with IRIB posting footage of the demolition. Jerusalem Post reported Iran executed a man detained during January protests for allegedly firing at police.
